system.description:
You collect and build illusionary chakra, attempting to bring about a spiral of lustful insanity, causing their eyes to glow with a Magenta color.

Select one creature you are aware of, that can hear you within range, forcing them to make a Wisdom saving throw.

Critical Success: Affected creature is able to resist this jutsu’s effects.

Success: Affected creature is Confused until the end of their next turn.

Failure: The first time the affected creature targets another creature, they become Charmed and treat that creature as the Compeller for the duration. While charmed in this way, this condition does not end if they are harmed and they remake their saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending this effect on a success.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, they now seek to aid or protect their Compeller for the duration.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of creatures you can target by +1.
